title: Should First Trust Large Cap Core AlphaDEX ETF (FEX) Be on Your Investing Radar?
author: Zacks.Com
description: First Trust Large Cap Core AlphaDEX ETF (FEX) is a passively managed large cap blend ETF with $1.55 billion in assets and a 0.57% expense ratio. The fund has returned 13.88% year-to-date and 16.07% over the past year, with a medium risk profile. It carries a Zacks ETF Rank of 3 (Hold), making it a sufficient option for large cap blend exposure, though competitors like Vanguard 500 Index Fund and iShares Core S&P 500 ETF offer lower expense ratios.

title: The Tech Interactive Welcomes Accenture Technology Leader Francesca Mazzoleni to Board of Directors
author: Not Specified
description: Francesca Mazzoleni, senior managing director at Accenture, has joined The Tech Interactive's board of directors. Mazzoleni brings over 20 years of experience in AI, enterprise transformation, and technology leadership. She currently leads Accenture's U.S. Communications, Media & High-Tech Industries Technology practice and previously served as global chief digital officer at Campari Group.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Accenture is highlighted as the employer of a highly accomplished executive being appointed to a prestigious board position, demonstrating the company's strength in developing technology and AI leadership talent.

title: Is ProShares S&P Technology Dividend Aristocrats ETF (TDV) a Strong ETF Right Now?
author: Zacks.Com
description: The ProShares S&P Technology Dividend Aristocrats ETF (TDV) is reviewed as a smart beta ETF with $274.64 million in assets, offering exposure to technology dividend-paying companies. With a 0.45% expense ratio and 1.04% dividend yield, it has returned 16.53% year-to-date and 18.53% over 12 months as of September 15, 2026. However, it carries higher risk with a beta of 1.11 and is more concentrated than peers with 39 holdings. The article suggests cheaper alternatives like DGRO and VIG for investors seeking lower-cost, lower-risk options.

title: CDW's $525M Lovelytics Buyout: Can Data & AI Services Boost Growth?
author: Na
description: CDW Corporation announced plans to acquire Lovelytics, a data and AI services firm, for approximately $525 million to strengthen its Data & Analytics Practice. The acquisition aims to help enterprises transition from AI pilots to production by combining Lovelytics' specialized expertise with CDW's scale and technology portfolio. The move reflects growing enterprise demand for AI data readiness solutions, with only 12% of enterprises feeling fully prepared according to Gartner research.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: CDW is making a strategic $525M acquisition to expand its Data & Analytics Practice and position itself as a comprehensive AI partner for enterprises. The company has outperformed its industry (13.6% gain vs 1.6% industry growth), trades at a lower P/E ratio (13.45 vs 18.32 industry average), and maintains a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) with upward earnings revisions, indicating strong execution and market opportunity.

Accenture is aggressively investing in high-growth areas through acquisitions, spending $1.5 billion across 23 acquisitions in fiscal 2025 and expecting $9 billion in fiscal 2026 investment.
